label: SCENARIO ASSUMPTIONS. None of these is a measured Built2Bid or contractor statistic. Benchmarks cited in the basis come from other advertisers and software companies and are used only as anchors.

assumptions.name: cpc_usd
assumptions.description: Cost per click by buy unit.
assumptions.basis: SEARCH base = Business Services 2026 median [CE012], conservative = Home & Home Improvement 2026 [CE011], optimistic = long-tail template keywords (assumption). META base = Home & Home Improvement traffic [CE019], optimistic = Business Services traffic [CE020], conservative = Home & Home Improvement leads objective [CE023] because optimizing for registrations raises CPC. LINKEDIN = third-party $5-10 range [CE047]. YOUTUBE, TIKTOK, PARTNERS: no benchmark found; analyst assumption.
assumptions.experiment: X05/X06/X08; X01 replaces SEARCH with a Keyword Planner forecast

assumptions.name: ctr_pct
assumptions.description: Click-through rate, used only to estimate impressions.
assumptions.basis: SEARCH medians for advertisers: 6.47% Home & Home Improvement [CE014], 6.10% Business Services [CE015], 5.65% Business Services in the prior year [CE009]. META: 1.28% for Home & Home Improvement advertisers [CE018], 1.38% for Business Services advertisers [CE021]; the conservative value is an assumption. Other units are assumptions; PARTNERS has no impression-based CTR.

assumptions.name: landing_conversion_pct
assumptions.description: Click to account created (sign_up / CompleteRegistration) on the trade landing page.
assumptions.basis: Anchors: search advertisers' median lead conversion 4.85-7.52% [CE013] [CE003]; freemium B2B visit-to-signup 9% for all traffic sources [CE032]. Paid social and video traffic is assumed to convert at half or less of search (assumption). Built2Bid has no measured paid-traffic conversion yet (0 accounts with UTM data at the 2026-11-16 baseline).

assumptions.name: activation_7d_pct
assumptions.description: Share of new accounts that reach 7-day activation (3+ meaningful line items, finalize, or send) as defined in docs/growth/ACTIVATION.md.
assumptions.basis: Assumption. The 2026-11-16 baseline had 8 non-test accounts and 3 finalized a bid [P1:E190], too few (and partly owner logins) to measure.

assumptions.name: activation_quality_multiplier
assumptions.description: Multiplier on F04 by buy unit: how much more or less likely a signup from this channel is a real contractor with a live estimate need.
assumptions.basis: Analyst judgment from purchase intent and targeting precision (see channel scores). Replace with per-channel activation from /admin/marketing.

assumptions.name: activated_to_paid_90d_pct
assumptions.description: Share of 7-day-activated accounts that start a paid subscription within 90 days of signup.
assumptions.basis: Assumption. Cross-check: base F04 x F06 = 3.6% of signups paying, inside the 3%-5% band that a survey of B2B software products calls good for freemium self-serve [CE035] and below the 5.5% freemium figure for those products [CE033]; a secondary compilation gives 2.6% for software products [CE038]. Those products charge more than Built2Bid. Built2Bid had 0 paying accounts [P1:E190].

assumptions.name: monthly_churn_pct
assumptions.description: Monthly logo churn of paying accounts.
assumptions.basis: Assumption; no low-price contractor-software churn source found. docs/growth/ADS.md used 5% and 10% as illustrations [P1:S14]. Annual plans lower effective churn.
assumptions.experiment: X11 (first read only at day 90; real churn needs 6+ months)

assumptions.name: employer_account_share
assumptions.description: Share of new paying accounts that are employer businesses (priced with Phase 1 employer ARPA) versus solo (solo ARPA).
assumptions.basis: Assumption. Self-serve ads skew to owner-operators; Phase 1 ARPA by type comes from real list prices plus an assumed plan mix (Phase 1 A07).

assumptions.name: payment_fees
assumptions.basis: Stated in docs/growth/ADS.md [P1:S14]; confirm against the Stripe account statement.

assumptions.name: variable_cost_pct_of_revenue
assumptions.description: Hosting, email and AI cost per paying account as a share of net revenue (1 - gross margin).
assumptions.basis: ADS.md assumed 85% gross margin [P1:S14]; replace with Tech Stack & Costs actuals.

assumptions.name: ltv_horizon_months
assumptions.description: LTV is capped at this many months of retained gross profit.
assumptions.basis: Analyst parameter to avoid infinite-tail LTV at low churn; matches the Phase 1 36-month SOM horizon.
